summary: NEXT Founders publishes a 2027 intake: applications open January 12 and close March 3, with programming May–August. Participation is free and equity-free; the program provides no direct investment.

proposed_event.name: NEXT Founders 2027
proposed_event.description: Education, mentorship and investor introductions for Canadian growth-stage founders. Free participation, no equity taken and no direct investment.

dates.date_range_text: Applications January 12–March 3, 2027. Program May–August 2027; exact days and cutoff time unpublished.
